set.body:
Purpose:
Use Scala 3 domain types to remove invalid states that Cats validation alone would merely detect later.

Scope:
- Replace contradictory ConfoundStrategy npcs/percentVariance fields with an optional PcaRetention ADT, retaining compatibility factories where needed.
- Make BidsQuery construction validate typed filename and entity patterns consistently; raw direct construction must not create regexes that later throw or silently mismatch.
- Use non-empty collection types or private constructors only where emptiness is semantically invalid, including query patterns, entity-filter values, and datatype extensions.
- Make EventsTable carry validated numeric onset/duration values so accessors do not reparse and discard impossible failures.
- Route BidsProjectLoader.readEventTableFiles through the typed events validation contract, or explicitly separate generic TSV and validated event-table methods.
- Keep opaque IDs and paths total at public trust boundaries.

Acceptance:
- Contradictory PCA retention cannot be constructed through the new core model.
- Invalid query patterns fail at construction on JVM and Scala.js.
- Event loading rejects malformed onset/duration with path-aware diagnostics.
- Compatibility tests cover current downstream call sites.
- No Cats abstraction replaces a clearer enum, opaque type, or smart constructor.
set.title: BIDS F3: eliminate invalid query, confound, and event states
